body.x: ON.EARZ bursts onto the U.S. scene with its “Listen with the Legends” series of top-quality, powerful headphones inspired by three of the biggest icons of past generations: AC/DC, Elvis Presley and James Dean. Vintage design coupled with high-performance, pristine audio is perfect for the nostalgic audiophile. ON.EARZ unveils this unique series at Booth #6127 (North Hall) at the Consumer Electronics Show in Las Vegas.

“ON.EARZ thrilled to showcase our ‘Listen with the Legends’ line at CES this year,” says David Peroo, Product Development Manager of ON.EARZ. “We’ve worked hard to develop a product that precisely embodies these generational icons; their personality, flare, and style. These headphones offer the user the best of the past and present: the latest in technology wrapped in a vintage design.”

Each headphone is created with exclusive materials, and offers the most advanced audio features available. Brushed aluminum and comfortable, soft materials are used in this series for a sleek and stylish appearance. The 40mm high performance dynamic drivers offer a unique audio experience for clear, perfect sound. The “Listen with the Legends” headphones boast the portability of a foldable design and removable cables making them ideal for travelers. An integrated microphone in the cable allows for easy, crystal clear calls.
